verdict.rationale: The pack shows Founder Law handles founder O-1 and H-1B petitions and International Entrepreneur Parole. Nothing in it explains how a founder's own startup can petition for them: no beneficial-ownership rules, no board or employer-control arrangements, and no reference to the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance. EB-1A self-petitioning and parole are different pathways and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents how my own startup can petition for me — beneficial-ownership rules, board or employer control arrangements, and the 2023+ USCIS founder guidance
